propositions: Implement IntrospectionTokenVerifier class that POSTs tokens to an RFC 7662 compliant introspection endpoint with client_secret_basic authentication, accepting only active:true responses and mapping RFC 7662 fields (scope, exp, sub, client_id, aud) to AccessToken.

Reject tokens when audience validation fails: deny if aud is absent and auth_introspection_allow_missing_aud=false (fail-closed default); deny if aud (string or array) does not match auth_resource_server_url; accept only when aud matches or is explicitly allowed absent.

Enforce fail-closed transport security: reject http:// endpoints at construction, require HTTPS only, validate no private/link-local hosts by default (opt-out via auth_introspection_allow_private_host=true), apply bounded timeouts (connect 5s / read 10s), and raise on non-200 status, timeout, or malformed JSON response (never yielding acceptance).

Set expires_at from exp field when present; set expires_at=None (never 0) when exp is absent to defer expiry checks to re-introspection on every request, with no caching in v1 to ensure instant revocation.

Register config fields auth_introspection_* in McpConfig and _SECTIONS['mcp'] schema coercer; derive REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_* env-var names in MCP_ENV_VARS and server.json; require auth_introspection_client_secret_env to reference a non-empty environment variable at startup or fail-closed.
